comparison.note: Differences include tentative boundary and title-only proposals; they are not validated errors or an accuracy estimate.

reviewStatusDefinitions.agree: No specific correction identified from the available frozen evidence; still provisional AI assessment.
reviewStatusDefinitions.change_suggested: Concrete second-review correction supported by frozen evidence; maintainer must adjudicate.
reviewStatusDefinitions.boundary_review_required: Definition, study design, modality, or evidence limitation requires an explicit boundary decision; suggested labels are conditional.
reviewStatusDefinitions.missing_abstract_unverified: Title-only assessment; neither the original nor proposed label is verified.

limitations: AI-assisted second review only, not human gold and not a domain-expert review.
Not a fully blinded annotation exercise: initial schema inspection exposed first-batch original labels; later batches were read before original-label comparison.
No full texts, network retrieval, or external disclosure. No classifier regex, generated scores, or keyword bulk labeling used for decisions.
Track policy for secondary/auxiliary pipeline steps, clinical reader versus independent-reader comparisons, single-task foundation adaptation, and future-image synthesis remains unresolved.
All 400 decisions were authored individually. Scripts only printed frozen batches, serialized explicit decisions, compared source values, counted coverage, and validated excerpts.
